page_title: PodPilot - Create a podcast series for your organization using AI

sources.entry: PodPilot - PodPilot is an AI tool designed to simplify the process of creating high-quality podcast series for organizations #paid

summary.name: PodPilot
summary.one_liner: PodPilot is an AI service that generates a podcast series for an organization from its website URL and user-specified topics, then publishes it to podcast platforms.
use_cases: Creating a podcast series for an organization without producing it manually
Turning a company website into podcast episodes
Publishing AI-generated episodes to Spotify and Apple Podcasts
Producing industry-topic audio content for a brand
summary.what_it_does: The user enters an organization's website URL and describes topics for the AI to investigate. The AI searches the web for information about the organization and its industry and uses it to create a podcast series. Episodes are published to platforms such as Spotify, Apple Podcasts and Google Podcasts with one click. The page lists three paid tiers with episode counts and maximum episode lengths. Sample podcasts are offered for several companies, though the page notes those companies are not customers.
notable: Generates episodes from an organization's website URL plus user-chosen topics
One-click publishing to Spotify, Apple Podcasts, Google Podcasts and others
Tiers from $199 to $1,999 per month; higher tiers remove the audio watermark
Page says the product has evolved into Buzz, a Meta ads analysis tool
caveats: Paid only: plans cost $199, $499 or $1,999 per month
Basic tier limits output to 1 podcast per month of up to 15 minutes; Basic includes a PodPilot audio watermark
Page states the product has evolved into Buzz, a separate Meta ads tool
